title: The pitch meeting that isn't
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: A car with Washington plates at Gully's. Two people who don't order. Wood not there.

panels.composition: Gully's lot. A clean car with Washington plates. Two PEOPLE in good jackets getting out, looking at the shack like it's a location.

image.prompt: a clean new car with Washington plates parked at a weathered bait-and-espresso shack, two people in expensive casual jackets getting out and appraising it, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: Inside. GULLY behind the counter. The two at the counter, not ordering. BARNABY II in the basket, growling very slightly.

balloons.text: We're looking for Arthur Finch. The cartoonist. We understand he's a regular.

image.prompt: two well-dressed visitors at a bait shop counter not ordering, a stocky man in an apron behind it, a three-legged dog in a basket on the counter growling faintly

balloons.text: We'd like to talk about the helicopter. There's real interest in—

image.prompt: close-up of a stocky man in an apron with a flat unmoving expression
image.notes: 'Arthur Finch' said by strangers: the world's paperwork again. Wood is not on the page.

panels.composition: The two leaving with lattes, a business card on the counter. Gully pinning the card to the corkboard face-in, next to nothing, then thinking better of it and dropping it in the bait cooler.

characters.pose: dropping a card in the bait cooler

image.prompt: a stocky man dropping a business card into a bait cooler behind a shop counter as two visitors leave with paper cups, a three-legged dog watching, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: The streaming people come to Gully's. Wood absent. The card goes in the bait cooler.
